title: SPEC-DATA-003 — Frappe / MariaDB Operational Database, Projection & UI Data Architecture Events
description: Document 113 event contract for WP-11 Document 71. Document 71 declares 0 owned entities and 1 read-only API; its 4 named events are Frappe-side (a projection worker inside apps/ebmr_frappe applying/rebuilding a DocType projection, and a server hook rejecting a direct field edit). apps/ebmr_frappe does not exist yet (ADR-0008 point 4: scaffolded module-by-module starting with WP-01 Document 04, not in bulk here) -- these payload shapes are committed ahead of implementation (Document 113 contract-first) using the shared app/modules/frappeproj/contract.py::PROJECTION_BASELINE_FIELDS envelope, same 'mechanism/contract present, runtime feed deferred' precedent as Document 66's zero-trust functions. Only 3 of the 4 are declared here: 'ProjectionStaleDetected' is Document 69's event (event-data-001.json, producer SPEC-DATA-001) -- a Frappe projection reports the identical staleness signal every other projection consumer already reports, so it reuses that single producer rather than registering a second one for the same event_type (CTRC-FR-008 / AG-05's 'no dual anything' spirit extended to events).
